profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI-First & Agentic Development
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer who works AI-first.  I use coding agents for implementation, code review, debugging, testing, and investigation while retaining ownership of architecture, requirements, technical judgment, validation, and shipped quality.

My career spans 15+ years across software engineering, quality engineering, and technical program leadership. I've worked on games, consoles, and VR as well as Windows desktop applications and cloud-backed services. That breadth taught me to consider how software behaves in the real world, how it fails, how we know it is healthy, and how we make it easier for the next engineer to work with.

Most recently at Microsoft, I worked across C#, C++/WinRT, and XAML codebases on Windows applications and AI services. I developed an AI text-generation feature from proof of concept to a production-ready state, implemented LLM response streaming, upgraded a service from GPT-3.5 Turbo to GPT-4o, and created a translation filter for prompts and generated content.

I also worked on responsible AI safeguards for Paint and Photos, including inclusive prompt refinements, human-reference detection, content protections, and reusable red-team testing.  I helped modernize production AI services, remediate security findings, support multi-region reliability, investigate production incidents, and improve health checks and monitoring.  My Windows application work included UI modernization, accessibility, and migration from UWP to the Windows App SDK.

I use GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude for day-to-day engineering while keeping human judgment and validation central to the process. I am also developing a personal router-and-guide system for making AI-assisted engineering workflows portable and maintainable.

Earlier in my career at Microsoft, I established quality-control procedures across multiple Windows applications and Microsoft Store, later expanding them into a sustainable multi-application program. I led cross-disciplinary programs, drove experimentation, and became a co-inventor on a published U.S. patent application.  Those experiences taught me to understand the problem before solving it, find the root cause, communicate clearly, and leave behind something durable.

I'm exploring software engineering opportunities where AI is part of how software is built or part of the product itself.  I'm especially interested in developing useful products, solving difficult technical problems, and improving reliability and engineering systems.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer on the Windows inbox apps team, contributing to Clock, Calculator, Camera, Notepad, Paint, Photos, and supporting AI services. Worked across C#, C++/WinRT, and XAML with a focus on AI features, responsible AI, modernization, reliability, and accessibility.

AI Feature Development
Developed an AI text-generation feature from proof of concept to a production-ready state, implementing service-side code, LLM response streaming, error handling, automated coverage, and end-to-end validation. Expanded multilingual experiences by upgrading an AI service from GPT-3.5 Turbo to GPT-4o and implementing a translation filter.

Responsible AI
Led prompt-engineering and responsible-AI work supporting Paint and Photos, including inclusive prompt refinements, human-reference detection, content safeguards, and reusable red-team scripts and documentation for independent safety evaluation.

Production Services & Reliability
Helped re-architect production AI services through automated Kusto deployments with Bicep, Geneva EV2 rollout and monitoring, multi-region support, certificate integration, CodeQL remediation, and safer SSL verification. Investigated and resolved production incidents, then implemented health checks, monitoring, and resilience improvements.

Windows Application Modernization
Migrated Clock's Timers Menu from UWP to the Windows App SDK, refactored Calculator UI architecture, updated Clock and Camera builds, and introduced a shared .editorconfig. Also contributed responsive UI and accessibility improvements.

AI-Assisted Engineering & Quality
Used GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude for implementation, code review, debugging, investigation, and long-running testing while retaining responsibility for technical decisions and validation. Improved CI and test infrastructure, restored a non-functional UI automation suite to reliably green status on the pull-request gate, and reduced a key flake rate from approximately 0.28 to 0.14.

positions.title: Technical Program Manager II
positions.description:
Led quality, experimentation, and technical programs for Windows inbox applications, combining program leadership with hands-on technical problem solving.

Quality Program Leadership
Expanded the quality-control procedures I had previously established into a multi-application program for Windows inbox apps and Microsoft Store. Led its execution and transitioned it to operate independently after I moved into another role.

Experimentation & Feature Delivery
Led the Windows app suite's first A/B experiment end-to-end, including experiment design, code implementation, data setup, coordination with Windows experimentation and release teams, release management, and collection and reporting of results that informed product decisions.

Separately implemented and shipped Visual Search with Bing in Snipping Tool, my first feature-development contribution before transitioning into a software engineering role.

Created reusable guidance and templates based on my experience designing, implementing, running, and releasing the app suite's first experiment.

Innovation & Prototyping
Co-invented “Efficient Generation of Code Development Summaries,” resulting in published U.S. Patent Application US20250138818A1. Prototyped a REST API-based testing tool and explored technical solutions to recurring quality challenges.

Technical Problem Solving & Team Support
Resolved complex device, environment, and self-hosting issues that blocked partner teams. Documented stable setup procedures so others could reproduce the solutions independently.

Responsible AI, Accessibility & Inclusion
Applied Microsoft Responsible AI training while supporting AI-related features. Contributed to accessibility efforts and advocated for inclusive product-development practices.

positions.title: Technical Program Manager
positions.description:
Coordinated quality, technical investigation, and program execution across Windows inbox applications and Microsoft Store, working with engineering, product, release, and test teams.

Quality & Cross-Team Collaboration
Coordinated testing throughout the development lifecycle and helped teams assess product quality, identify risks, resolve issues, and make informed release decisions.

Technical Investigation & Problem Solving
Investigated application behavior, features, devices, test environments, and development processes. Translated findings into actionable technical guidance that helped unblock engineering work.

Experimentation & Project Leadership
Evaluated opportunities to bring controlled experimentation to Windows applications. Provided technical program and project leadership for a hackathon project, helping the team move from concept through execution.

Accessibility & Inclusive Product Development
Partnered with accessibility advocates and incorporated accessibility and neurodiversity perspectives into feature planning and product discussions.

positions.title: Program Manager
positions.description:
Established quality-control processes across Windows inbox applications and Microsoft Store as a member of the Microsoft Apps, Partners, and Store team within Windows + Devices.

Quality Program Development
Designed and implemented quality-control procedures for Calculator, Camera, Clock, Maps, Notepad, Snipping Tool, Sound Recorder, and Microsoft Store, combining manual and automated testing.

Cross-Functional Coordination
Partnered with product managers, engineers, release managers, and external vendors to communicate quality status, coordinate testing, and resolve issues throughout the development lifecycle.

Release Readiness & Risk
Identified quality risks, helped teams evaluate release readiness, and worked with Release Management to establish meaningful checkpoints in the application release process.

Vendor Coordination & Process Improvement
Reviewed vendor testing tasks, reports, and deliverables while refining the broader quality program based on stakeholder input and evolving product needs.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer II
positions.description: Contracted through Experis to Amazon, supporting Amazon Game Studios.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer II
positions.description:
Contracted through Insight Global to Microsoft, supporting quality engineering for Windows inbox applications.

Test Process & Quality Engineering
Established the team’s testing process by designing and implementing test workflows, reporting structures, and reusable documentation.

Test Planning & Execution
Created test plans, test cases, test reports, and templates for Windows inbox apps, combining manual and automated testing throughout the development lifecycle.

Windows Self-Hosting & Release Validation
Self-hosted Windows OS builds during flighting and release cycles to identify application and OS integration issues before broader release.

Cross-Team Investigation & Tooling
Worked across Windows teams to reproduce difficult issues found during self-hosting, help engineers investigate root causes, and contribute feedback toward improving internal testing and diagnostic tooling.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer II
positions.description:
Contracted through Insight Global to Microsoft, supporting the Minecraft Platform team.

Feature & Platform Validation
Reviewed pull requests and user stories to identify test requirements, create test tasks, and coordinate validation work across internal and external test teams.

Quality Analysis & Reporting
Reviewed test results and produced reports assessing the quality of Minecraft platform systems and features.

Content-Creation Validation
Created, reviewed, tested, maintained, and occasionally fixed validation packs using Minecraft behavior packs and resource packs. These packs demonstrated and validated content-creation scenarios involving custom items, entities, blocks, animations, particles, and related functionality.

Technical Documentation
Authored step-by-step instructions for creating validation packs, helping make the process reproducible for other team members.

positions.title: QA Technician
positions.description:
Contracted through Experis to Amazon, supporting the Front of House QA team.
 
Hardware & Software Testing
 Tested point-of-sale/point-of-interaction (POS/POI) systems, electronic shelf label (ESL) devices, and the Amazon Books store website.
 
Test Development & Reporting
 Created and updated test cases, executed validation, and documented test results to support product quality and release decisions.

positions.title: Sr. QA Analyst
positions.description:
Worked closely with engineers and content creators to ensure the quality of an internal application used to build and develop games.

Test Engineering & Automation
Created, maintained, and documented manual test coverage and used Ranorex to develop automated BVT and smoke-test passes.

Investigation & Validation
Investigated defects, assisted other QA team members with complex bugs, performed clean-machine testing, and supported game testing as needed.

Developer & Content-Creator Support
Helped developers and content creators validate new builds, troubleshoot issues, and successfully adopt changes to the internal development application.

positions.title: QA Analyst
positions.description:
Contracted through Volt to Oculus, supporting Oculus Rift, Oculus Touch, and first-party content developed for the platform.

Hardware, Software & Content Testing
Conducted hardware/software testing and validated first-party experiences developed to ship with Oculus Rift and Oculus Touch controllers.

Test Process Development
Helped establish the QA process for Oculus first-party content and authored test cases, test specifications, and quality reports throughout development.

Documentation Standards & Leadership
Created the team's “Content QA Documentation Manual,” establishing guidance for documentation creation and control. Developed reusable templates for test and design plans, test and design reports, specifications, and other documents used throughout the product development lifecycle.

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description:
Contracted through Volt to DropForge Games / WG Cells, supporting quality testing for casual mobile games.

Game & Device Testing
Tested casual game titles across iOS devices, focusing on gameplay quality and device-specific behavior.

Black-Box Testing
Performed primarily exploratory/ad hoc and playability testing to identify functional and user-experience issues.

Bug Reporting & Test Results
Documented defects and produced test-result reports to support development and release decisions.

positions.title: Test Associate 2
positions.description:
Contracted through Experis to Microsoft Xbox R&D, supporting pre-release network and platform validation for Xbox One.

Network & Platform Testing
Used command-line tools and batch scripts to perform assisted automated testing of Xbox One network-backbone functionality prior to launch.

Conducted secure-socket and data-exchange testing across scenarios involving latency, bandwidth, private payloads, TCP, port changes, and network interruptions.

Network Topology Testing
Validated connectivity across different router and network configurations, including UPnP, port forwarding, and hairpinning. Streamlined topology testing so the area could be validated more efficiently.

Documentation & Team Leadership
Authored bug reports, test results, and status documentation. During a period of team transition, stepped into a leadership role to help maintain consistent, reliable results that leadership could use for decision-making.

positions.title: Sr. QA Analyst
positions.description:
Supported quality testing across multiple game and software projects, adapting testing approaches to the needs of each product.
 
Compatibility & Functional Testing
 Configured hardware and software environments to conduct compatibility and functional testing across a variety of projects.
 
Test Documentation
 Created bug reports and test reports, maintained test cases, and documented results for development teams.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Supported quality engineering for a large-scale, multi-platform software project.
 
Test Design & Execution
 Created and executed detailed test specifications, test scenarios, and functional test cases across supported platforms.
 
Defect Investigation
 Reproduced test results, investigated outstanding issues, and critically evaluated defects to provide clear, actionable information to development teams.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer II
positions.description:
Contracted through Artech to Microsoft, supporting product quality and feature validation.
 
Test Ownership & Product Influence
 Owned assigned product areas, evaluated test coverage, identified gaps, and contributed feedback that influenced product direction and specifications.
 
Test Engineering
 Created test cases, test specifications, and supporting documentation; analyzed results and adjusted coverage as the product evolved.
 
Leadership & Defect Management
 Provided leadership when needed and identified, investigated, and reported software defects.

positions.title: QA Test Associate
positions.description:
Contracted through Volt to Sandlot Games, supporting quality testing for casual PC games.
 
Game Testing
 Performed black-box testing with an emphasis on exploratory/ad hoc testing and gameplay quality.
 
Defect Reporting
 Identified, reproduced, and documented issues for the development team.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer II
positions.description:
Contracted through Excell Data to Microsoft, supporting the Windows Mobile Device team.
 
Build & Device Validation
 Performed manual and automated testing to assess build stability for internal dogfood testing and validated private builds for development engineers.
 
Technical Investigation & Documentation
 Identified and reported high-visibility defects and created documentation covering tools, devices, and test procedures.
 
Team Support & Training
 Served as a resource for questions about tools, devices, test procedures, and build testability, and trained new team members.

positions.title: QA Test Associate
positions.description:
Tested console, PC, and web-based software across a wide range of hardware and operating-system configurations.
 
Multi-Platform Game Testing
 Tested titles for Xbox 360, PlayStation 2, PSP, Nintendo Wii, and PC.
 
Functional, Compatibility & Compliance Testing
 Performed black-box testing including functional, compatibility, exploratory/ad hoc, gameplay, and platform-compliance testing (TRC, TCR, Lotcheck).
 
Test Planning
 Contributed to test strategies and test plans and, between game projects, created test cases for an undisclosed web application.

positions.title: Test Associate
positions.description:
Contracted through Excell Data to Microsoft Game Studios on the Reserves team.
 
Game & Platform Testing
 Tested AAA Xbox 360 and PC game titles using functional, compatibility, exploratory, gameplay, and platform-compliance testing.
 
Hardware Testing
 Conducted hardware/software validation for the Xbox HD DVD Player.
 
Team Support
 Helped onboard and support new team members as they learned project processes and testing practices.

projects.title: Space Siege
projects.description: Full time Quality Assurance testing for Gas Powered Games on PC released title Space Siege (Action). Primary emphasis on BVT’s and Game Content. Duties include, Build Verification Testing, quick and efficient Campaign Play-throughs, extensive compatibility testing, performance testing, crash debugging and analysis, database entry and bug filing. Created and updated test cases for specific test passes.
